notes:
Account brief:
- Vertical: federal civic intelligence + state defense use cases. Highly sensitive corpus (policy memos, classified-ish governance docs, operational logs).
- Primary problem: fast, accurate search over very large corpus (est. 20TB raw, ~50M candidate passages). Need embeddings + reranking pipeline; want to minimize vector index size and reranker latency.
- Targets called out by engineering: p95 end-to-end query < 200ms for metadata-filtered queries, p99 < 500ms in steady state; burst throughput target 600 qps; cost-per-query goal <$0.02 (hosted-equivalent).
- Deployment constraint: must run in customer-controlled air-gapped datacenter (FISMA-high equivalent), HSM-backed KMS, no egress. Private/on-prem only.
- Model preferences: open weights (Llama2/Redwood-verified variants) quantized int8/4 for embedding candidate generation; cross-encoder reranker can be smaller specialized model (distilled cross-attention) but will run on same private cluster.
- Indexing scale concerns: expect frequent reindexing windows (daily incremental + monthly full), retention 7+ years, compliance retention/rolloff rules. Need sharding strategy and cold storage plan.
- Ops: strict audit logging, per-token cost visibility, per-route SLOs. Procurement asks for runbook, incident response, and SLAs.
